_note: Conditions rules. Thresholds marked app_threshold are our own cut-offs for when to show a flag, not numbers from the cited source. Edit here; backend and frontend fallback both read this file.

source.name: UF/IFAS Extension, Water pH and the Effectiveness of Pesticides (PI193)

bands.text: Below the usual 4 to 7 mixing band. Check the product label before mixing.
Inside the 4 to 7 band UF/IFAS recommends for mixing most pesticides (5.5 to 6.5 is ideal).
Alkaline water. UF/IFAS recommends mixing most pesticides at pH 4 to 7; alkaline water above pH 7 can break down sensitive products in the tank. Consider treating the water and check the label.

flags.text: High UV right now - sunlight inactivates Bt spores, so late-evening spraying protects them.

source.name: Griego & Spence 1978, Applied and Environmental Microbiology 35(5)

flags.text: Very hot - the BotaniGard label warns live spores are harmed by high temperatures. Keep the product cool until the tank.

weather.no_flag_text: No weather flag for this product type right now.
